title: Enterprise Support: Reviewed quantity fee reconstruction for source-line debit assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Reviewed quantity fee reconstruction for source-line debit assessment.

## Decision basis

For source-line debit assessment: Reconstruct the approved rectified fee from its reviewed vCPU-hours, the effective cloud rate, the support fee fraction and its single discount; apply the monthly minimum after discounting.

## Hypothetical case

For source-line debit assessment: Suppose reviewed hours are hypothetically 1000, effective cloud price is USD 0.50, support fraction is 20 percent, selected discount is 25 percent and monthly minimum is USD 90. The discounted reconstructed subtotal is USD 75; the fee is USD 90 after the minimum.
